The '''Federal Correctional Institution, Big Spring''' ('''FCI Big Spring''') is a low-security United States [[federal prison]] for male inmates in [[Texas]]. It is operated by the [[Federal Bureau of Prisons]], a division of the [[United States Department of Justice]]. The facility also has a satellite prison camp which houses minimum-security male offenders.

FCI Big Spring is located in the city of [[Big Spring, Texas]], midway between [[Dallas]] and [[El Paso, Texas|El Paso]].<ref>{{cite web|title=FCI Big Spring|url=https://www.bop.gov/locations/institutions/big/index.jsp|publisher=Federal Bureau of Prisons}}</ref>  The town is also the location of the privately owned and operated [[Big Spring Correctional Center]], which contracts with the FBOP to house federal detainees at four locations.  Both FCI Big Spring and the BSCC occupy buildings and facilities repurposed from the closed [[Webb Air Force Base]].
